n = int(input())
t = int(input())

INF = 12345678

class Node:
    def __init__(self, i=0, j=0, no=0):
        self.i = i
        self.j = j
        self.no = no

class Capacity:
    def __init__(self):
        self.no = [0]*1000
        self.ind = 0
        self.fl = 0

caps = [[Capacity() for _ in range(100)] for _ in range(100)]
v = [[] for _ in range(1000)]
left = [-1]*1000
right = [-1]*1000
col = [0]*1000
grid = ["" for _ in range(1000)]
grid1 = ["" for _ in range(1000)]
d = [[INF]*1000 for _ in range(1000)]
d1 = [[INF]*1000 for _ in range(1000)]
from collections import deque

def bfs(s):
    for i in range(n+1):
        for j in range(n+1):
            d[i][j] = INF
    i, j = s.i, s.j
    d[i][j] = 0
    q = deque()
    q.append(s)
    while q:
        temp = q.popleft()
        i, j = temp.i, temp.j
        if grid[i][j] == 'Y' or grid[i][j] == 'Z':
            continue
        if caps[i][j].fl == 1:
            if d[i][j] <= t:
                for l in range(1, caps[i][j].ind + 1):
                    v[s.no].append(caps[i][j].no[l])
        for dir in range(4):
            di = [1, -1, 0, 0]
            dj = [0, 0, 1, -1]
            ni = i + di[dir]
            nj = j + dj[dir]
            if 0 <= ni < n and 0 <= nj < n:
                if d[ni][nj] > d[i][j] + 1:
                    d[ni][nj] = d[i][j] + 1
                    q.append(Node(ni, nj, 0))

def bfst(s):
    for i in range(n+1):
        for j in range(n+1):
            d1[i][j] = INF
    i, j = s.i, s.j
    d1[i][j] = 0
    q2 = deque()
    q2.append(s)
    while q2:
        temp = q2.popleft()
        i, j = temp.i, temp.j
        if grid[i][j] == 'Y' or grid[i][j] == 'Z':
            continue
        if caps[i][j].fl == 1:
            if d1[i][j] <= t:
                for l in range(1, caps[i][j].ind + 1):
                    v[s.no].append(caps[i][j].no[l])
        for dir in range(4):
            di = [1, -1, 0, 0]
            dj = [0, 0, 1, -1]
            ni = i + di[dir]
            nj = j + dj[dir]
            if 0 <= ni < n and 0 <= nj < n:
                if d1[ni][nj] > d1[i][j] + 1:
                    d1[ni][nj] = d1[i][j] + 1
                    q2.append(Node(ni, nj, 0))

def dfs(s):
    if col[s]:
        return False
    col[s] = 1
    for i in range(len(v[s])):
        k = v[s][i]
        if left[k] == -1:
            left[k] = s
            right[s] = i
            return True
        elif dfs(left[k]):
            left[k] = s
            right[s] = i
            return True
    return False

def match(n):
    for i in range(1000):
        left[i] = -1
        right[i] = -1
    res = 0
    done = False
    while True:
        done = True
        for i in range(1000):
            col[i] = 0
        for i in range(1, n+1):
            if right[i] == -1 and dfs(i):
                done = False
        if done:
            break
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        if right[i] != -1:
            res += 1
    return res

n = int(input())
t = int(input())

for i in range(n):
    grid[i] = input().strip()

for i in range(n):
    grid1[i] = input().strip()

mark = 1
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        if grid[i][j] == 'Z':
            temp = Node(i, j, 0)
            bfs(temp)

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        if grid1[i][j].isdigit():
            k = int(grid1[i][j])
            if k > 0:
                caps[i][j].fl = 1
            caps[i][j].ind = k
            for l in range(1, k+1):
                caps[i][j].no[l] = mark
                mark += 1

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        if grid[i][j].isdigit():
            k = int(grid[i][j])
            for l in range(1, k+1):
                temp_node = Node(i, j, 0)
                temp_node.no = mark
                bfst(temp_node)
                mark += 1

print(match(mark - 1))
